words.sense: An independently minded person who breaks with group practices or expectations.
misconceptions: Confuses doing things differently with attacking received ideas.
Assumes criticizing tradition is merely personal independence.

words.sense: A person who openly challenges or attacks established beliefs, traditions, or accepted authorities.
misconceptions: Confuses doing things differently with attacking received ideas.
Assumes criticizing tradition is merely personal independence.

semantic_axes.description: A maverick follows an independent path; an iconoclast actively contests the accepted ideas or traditions themselves.

edges.boundary_rule: A maverick follows an independent path; an iconoclast actively contests the accepted ideas or traditions themselves.

misconceptions.M1: Confuses doing things differently with attacking received ideas.
misconceptions.M2: Assumes criticizing tradition is merely personal independence.
misconceptions.M3: Uses attention or popularity as the distinguishing test.

chains.frame: Which word best describes Yara’s approach in the debate club?

beats.text: Yara prepares cases alone and uses a structure unlike the club’s usual template.
beats.decisive_clue: independent method without attacking the group’s ideas
beats.reason: The first beat supplies the deciding evidence: independent method without attacking the group’s ideas.

beats.text: She respects teammates who prefer the standard method.
beats.decisive_clue: independent method without attacking the group’s ideas
beats.reason: Accepting others’ methods does not make her own approach conventional.

chains.feedback_short: Independent method without attacking the group’s ideas is what distinguishes maverick here.
chains.feedback_deep: Maverick means an independently minded person who breaks with group practices or expectations. Iconoclast means a person who openly challenges or attacks established beliefs, traditions, or accepted authorities. Here, independent method without attacking the group’s ideas; accepting others’ methods does not make her own approach conventional.
chains.contrast_rule: A maverick follows an independent path; an iconoclast actively contests the accepted ideas or traditions themselves.
